data.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'fatha' which means 'to open' or 'to expand', Fathiyyaat is a name that symbolizes the opening of the heavens, granting blessings and guidance. In Islamic spirituality, it represents the journey of seeking knowledge and wisdom from the divine. The name Fathiyyaat carries the meaning “Opening of the heavens” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fathiyyaat usually hope their child will grow to embody opening of the heavens and live with faith, good character and purpose.
